expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
Planned v2 work will expand the protocol beyond the current `Msg::Ping` message with additional message types, clearer and more robust serialization and validation, and round-trip coverage for each supported message, while preserving compatibility with existing ping clients where practical.

Shipped v2 `Msg::Hello(String)` with an explicit `v:2` envelope and round-trip coverage.
